part.doubledPawns.title: Doubled pawns
part.doubledPawns.summary: Two pawns on the same file cannot defend each other; before trading, weigh that weakness against what the other side gets.
ex.dp.BS4K9: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.dp.BS4K9.hint: Your pawns are doubled on f2 and f3. See what the recapture left open for your pieces.
ex.dp.BS4K9.solution: 20.Qxg8#! The queen goes up the g-file, which has no white pawn, and takes the rook with mate: the bishop on a2 guards g8.
ex.dp.w6sSX: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.dp.w6sSX.hint: Your pawns are doubled on f7 and f5. See what the recapture left open for your pieces.
ex.dp.w6sSX.solution: 18...Qxg2#! The queen goes down the g-file, which has no black pawn, and takes the pawn on g2 with mate: the bishop on b7 defends it.
ex.dp.xf5j5: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.dp.xf5j5.hint: Your pawns are doubled on f6 and f4. See what the recapture left open for your pieces.
ex.dp.xf5j5.solution: 30...Rg1#! The rook goes down the g-file, which has no pawns, and gives mate, defended by the queen on h2. 30...Qg1+ also wins, but it is not mate.
ex.dp.vx0BM: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.dp.vx0BM.hint: Your pawns are doubled on f2 and f4, and the g-file is yours. Count the pieces that attack g7.
ex.dp.vx0BM.solution: 44.Qxg7#! The queen takes the rook on g7, defended by the rook on g1 along the g-file, and it is mate.
ex.dp.ej33x: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.dp.ej33x.hint: Black's pawns are doubled on g7 and g5. See who defends the front one.
ex.dp.ej33x.solution: 45.Kxg5! captures the pawn on g5: the one on g7 is on the same file and does not defend it. After 45...Ke6, which attacks the pawn on e5, 46.Kf4 protects it.
ex.dp.bsWkL: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.dp.bsWkL.hint: White's pawns are doubled on c2 and c4. See who defends the front one.
ex.dp.bsWkL.solution: 34...Kc5! attacks the pawn on c4: the one on c2 is behind it, on the same file, and does not defend it, so only the white king protects it. After 35.Ke4, which attacks the pawn on e5, 35...Kxc4 captures the pawn.
ex.dp.32Qnx: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.dp.32Qnx.hint: White's pawns are doubled on c2 and c3, and the white king is on the third rank.
ex.dp.32Qnx.solution: 42...Rxc3+! captures the pawn on c3 with check: the one on c2 does not defend it. After 43.Rd3, which blocks the check, 43...exd3 captures the rook.
ex.dp.Ds7fe: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.dp.Ds7fe.hint: The black pawn on f4 stands in front of the one on f7, which does not defend it. Look also at what the black queen defends.
ex.dp.Ds7fe.solution: 30.Rxf4! captures the pawn on f4, which the one on f7 does not defend, and attacks the queen. After 30...Qg5, 31.Rg4 pins the queen to the king on g7.
ex.dp.FbUZ6: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.dp.FbUZ6.hint: One black piece is undefended. And the black pawn on f4 lacks the defence of the one on f6, which stands behind it on the same file.
ex.dp.FbUZ6.solution: 45.Rxa7+! captures the loose bishop with check. After 45...Kg6, 46.gxf4 captures the pawn on f4: the one on f6, on the same file, does not defend it.
